sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Allows the state liquor authority to issue a retail license for on-premises consumption for a premises which shall be located within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship.

sponsored.t: Limits the availability of certain special number plates
sponsored.sum: Requires special number plates reserved for elected public officers to only be available to such elected public officers during their term of office and must be surrendered to the department upon the end of such term.

sponsored.t: Prohibits copycat cannabis products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits cannabis products, or packaging or labeling for a cannabis product, that are substantially similar to or likely to create confusion with a non-cannabis product.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York city housing authority to promptly investigate and remove squatters from its apartments
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city housing authority to investigate complaints of squatters within twenty-four hours and promptly remove squatters from its apartments.

sponsored.t: Creates an identification card program for local correctional facilities; and relates to issuance of and waiver of fees for identification cards issued pursuant to certain identification card programs
sponsored.sum: Creates an identification card program for incarcerated individuals in local correctional facilities; requires such identification cards to be identical to non-driver identification cards issued to the general public; waives fees for such identification cards.

sponsored.t: Provides remedies for disrupted elections
sponsored.sum: Provides remedies for disrupted voting times and locations during elections; directs that the BOE extend voting to account for the disruption.

sponsored.t: Relates to the qualifications to serve as a member of the citywide council on English language learners and of the citywide council on high schools
sponsored.sum: Allows parents of a child who has ever received services through an English as a second language program to serve as a member of the citywide council on English language learners and of the citywide council on high schools even if the child is no longer enrolled.

sponsored.t: Enacts "India's law"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "India's law" under which an incarcerated individual's next of kin shall be notified and allowed visitation by a local correctional facility when such individual is experiencing a serious medical event or demonstrating behavior that is likely to result in serious harm to themselves or others.

sponsored.t: Establishes an economic grant program for the Second Avenue Subway construction project area
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes an economic development grant program for the Second Avenue Subway construction project area.

sponsored.t: Permits certain members of the state liquor authority or officers, deputies, assistants, inspectors or employees thereof to be a member of a community board of education
sponsored.sum: Permits certain members of the state liquor authority or officers, deputies, assistants, inspectors or employees thereof to be a member of a board of education.

sponsored.t: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits
sponsored.sum: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue.

sponsored.t: Grants certain first responders free use of state parks and campsites
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Enacts the heroes park pass act to grant certain first responders free use of state parks and campsites.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 125th Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 125th Street Luther Vandross station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 125th Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 125th street - Luther Vandross station.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of metal detectors at all general hospital public entrances
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of metal detectors at all general hospital public entrances.

sponsored.t: Limits the hours of certain businesses located near schools
sponsored.sum: Prohibits adult-use dispensing facilities and tobacco businesses from opening until one hour after the latest beginning of a school day of any school located within one mile of the facility or business.

sponsored.t: Relates to employment at certain licensees for the purposes of parole conditions
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that employment at any licensee under the cannabis law satisfies employment requirements for parole, probation or other state supervision unless the terms and conditions of said parole, probation, or state supervision explicitly prohibit such employment.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing body-worn cameras to certain individuals visiting correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to provide body-worn cameras to certain individuals visiting correctional facilities and provide those individuals with the footage from such cameras.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 116th Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 116th Street - Tito Puente station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 116th Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 116th Street - Tito Puente station.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 103rd Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 103rd Street - Cicely Tyson station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 103rd Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 103rd Street - Cicely Tyson station.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 110th Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 110th Street - Eddie Palmieri station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 110th Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 110th Street - Eddie Palmieri station.

sponsored.t: Relates to reducing a correction officer's pension to satisfy certain judgments
sponsored.sum: Relates to reducing a correction officer's pension to satisfy certain judgments from the death or hospitalization of an incarcerated individual; provides that a correction officer's pension may be reduced to no less than $20,000 to satisfy a judgment; provides that a court shall hold a hearing to determine the amount of the reduction.

sponsored.t: Relates to the role of the attorney-general as the head of the department of justice and of the chief state's attorney as the head of the department of law
sponsored.sum: Increases the maximum number of civil departments in the state government to twenty-one; relates to the role of the attorney-general as the head of the department of justice; creates the role of the chief state's attorney as the head of the department of law.

sponsored.t: Waives certain licensure fees for seniors
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensure fees for seniors.

sponsored.t: Provides for rules and regulations for strip searches in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the state commission of correction to promulgate rules and regulations for strip searches in correctional facilities which at a minimum include a requirement that no fewer than two staff members shall be present for any strip search.

sponsored.t: Provides for money upon release for certain incarcerated individuals; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Provides for eligible incarcerated individuals to receive a monthly stipend upon release from a state correctional facility.

sponsored.t: Requires foster care records of incarcerated individual to be sent to a correctional facility
sponsored.sum: Requires foster care records of incarcerated individuals to be sent to the correctional facility.

sponsored.t: Relates to conferring youthful offender status upon conviction of an eligible youth for a misdemeanor
sponsored.sum: Relates to conferring youthful offender status upon conviction of an eligible youth for a misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Creates parity for incarcerated individual telephone services for international calls to family members
sponsored.sum: Creates parity for incarcerated individual telephone services for international calls to family members outside continental United States, Canada, U.S. Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, Guam or Central Northern Mariana Islands by requiring identical restrictions on the duration or number of phone calls and use of unit or facility phones made available to incarcerated individuals who are calling family members who are not outside continental United States, Canada, U.S. Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, Guam or Central Northern Mariana Islands.

sponsored.t: Relates to the age of persons eligible for a sentence of life imprisonment without parole
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that only persons eighteen years of age and older may be sentenced to life imprisonment without parole.

sponsored.t: Enacts "the prison wage act" relating to payment for labor performed by incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Enacts "the prison wage act" relating to payment for labor performed by incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Establishes Three King's day as a school holiday
sponsored.sum: Establishes Three King's day as a school holiday for all public schools in a city school district of a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of emergency management release plans to be developed for use in correctional facilities in the event of a state disaster emergency declared pursuant to executive order
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of emergency management release plans to be developed for use in correctional facilities in the event of a state disaster emergency declared pursuant to executive order; establishes an advisory board to provide recommendations for the development of such plans; establishes criteria to be used to determine eligibility for emergency release of incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate issues affecting reentry of incarcerated individuals released from correctional facilities; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate issues affecting reentry of incarcerated individuals released from correctional facilities; appropriates $250,000 therefor.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York city council to oversee the activities of the New York city housing authority
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York city council to oversee the activities of the New York city housing authority.

sponsored.t: Provides for the creation and maintenance of digital records for each incarcerated individual
sponsored.sum: Provides for the creation and maintenance of digital records for each incarcerated individual which includes all medical records, including but not limited to mental health records and results of drug or alcohol tests, work records and evaluations, conduct records and programming records.

sponsored.t: Memorializes Robert F. Kennedy, Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. and Dr. Pedro Albizu Campos by naming spans of the Triborough bridge after them
sponsored.sum: Memorializes Robert F. Kennedy, Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. and Dr. Pedro Albizu Campos by naming spans of the Triborough bridge after them.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing voting by incarcerated individuals in correctional facilities; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing voting by incarcerated individuals in correctional facilities; requires the department of corrections and community supervision, in collaboration with the state and county boards of election, to establish a program to facilitate incarcerated individuals voter registration and voting.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of mental health to conduct a study on the effects of abuse suffered while incarcerated on formerly incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of mental health to conduct a study on the effects of abuse suffered while incarcerated on formerly incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Removes the lifetime ban on jury duty for convicted felons
sponsored.sum: Removes the lifetime ban on jury duty for convicted felons.

sponsored.t: Enacts the PTSD awareness and rehabilitation act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the PTSD awareness and rehabilitation act to require PTSD screening, provide trauma-informed education, and implement evidence-based rehabilitation programs to ensure incarcerated individuals receive proper support for mental health challenges.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to study the transportation and housing needs of Randalls and Wards Islands
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in consultation with the New York city department of transportation and New York city department of housing preservation and development, to study the transportation and housing needs of Randalls and Wards Islands.

sponsored.t: Provides for money upon release for certain incarcerated individuals; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the reentry assistance program; provides for eligible incarcerated individuals to receive a monthly stipend upon release from a state correctional facility; makes an appropriation of $25,000,000.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the state inspector general to receive and investigate complaints of sexual assault in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state inspector general to receive and investigate complaints of sexual assault in correctional facilities and other places operated by the department of corrections and community supervision for the confinement of persons; requires the state inspector general to establish protocol and procedures for such reports and investigations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers and duties of district attorneys
sponsored.sum: Empowers district attorneys to review and release at their discretion, all footage from body worn cameras utilized by law enforcement agencies within the county of such district attorney.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to pay for independent autopsies of incarcerated individuals who die in custody
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to pay for independent autopsies at the request of the next of kin of incarcerated individuals who die in the custody of the department of corrections and community supervision.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to pay for the delivery of the body of a deceased incarcerated individual to their next of kin
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to pay for the delivery of the body of a deceased incarcerated individual to their next of kin when such incarcerated individual dies in the custody of the department of corrections and community supervision.

sponsored.t: Requires disciplinary hearings for incarcerated individuals to be recorded
sponsored.sum: Requires disciplinary hearings for incarcerated individuals to be recorded with both audio and visual components; requires such recordings to be preserved; directs the commissioner of the department of corrections and community supervision to promulgate rules and regulations for who can access such recordings and when such recordings can be accessed.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the detainment of minors with adult detainees
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the detainment of minors with adult detainees in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Requires the state education department to develop a model mental health training program to serve as the mental health component of required school safety trainings
sponsored.sum: Requires the state education department to develop a model mental health training program to serve as the mental health component of required school safety trainings as part of comprehensive district-wide safety plans developed by each district-wide school safety team.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions of law relating to publishers or manufacturers providing printed instructional materials for college students with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions of law relating to publishers or manufacturers providing printed instructional materials for college students with disabilities.
